description: This Java class defines the OrderGroup entity in the OpenMRS healthcare platform, encapsulating a group of medical orders associated with a patient encounter. It manages relationships, ordering, and nesting of order groups and includes methods for adding and managing orders within the group.

classes.name: OrderGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of orders associated with a patient encounter, supporting nested groupings, ordering, and grouping reasons within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getOrderGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of this order group.

methods.name: setOrderGroupId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this order group.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with this order group.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with this order group.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the encounter linked to this order group.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the encounter linked to this order group.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns the list of orders contained in this group.

methods.name: setOrders
methods.description: Replaces the list of orders in this group.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Adds a single order to this group.

methods.name: addOrders
methods.description: Adds multiple orders to this group.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Adds an order at a specific position, automatically setting sort weight.

methods.name: findListIndexForGivenPosition
methods.description: Determines the list index based on the desired position, handling negative and out-of-range values.

methods.name: findSortWeight
methods.description: Calculates the sort weight for an order based on its position in the list.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Returns the associated order set.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Assigns an order set to this group.

methods.name: getParentOrderGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the parent order group for nesting purposes.

methods.name: setParentOrderGroup
methods.description: Sets the parent order group for nesting.

methods.name: getOrderGroupReason
methods.description: Gets the concept representing the reason for ordering this group.

methods.name: setOrderGroupReason
methods.description: Sets the reason (concept) for ordering this group.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the previous order group in case of sequential grouping.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderGroup
methods.description: Sets the previous order group.

methods.name: getNestedOrderGroups
methods.description: Returns nested order groups, supporting group nesting.

methods.name: setNestedOrderGroups
methods.description: Sets nested order groups for complex groupings.
